questions.prompt: Which of the following is an arithmetic sequence?
questions.feedbackIfWrong: 3, 6, 9, 12, 15 has a constant difference of 3, so it is arithmetic.

What is the sum of the first 10 positive integers?

questions.prompt: The sum formula for an arithmetic series is $ S_n = n \left( \frac{a_1 + a_n}{2} \right) $. The expression $ \frac{a_1 + a_n}{2} $ is the:
questions.feedbackIfWrong: It is the average (or mean) of the first and last terms.
